{{Top|leg}}
A '''Capture Permit''' was a permit required by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] after the target's capture. They were issued after the capture, and cost twenty-five percent of the bounty, or 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], whichever was the higher amount.
